title: Tribal Movements Santhal Rebellion
definition: The Santhal Rebellion (Hul) of 1855-56 was a massive armed uprising by the Santhal community against the oppressive colonial administration, zamindars, and moneylenders (dikus) in the Damin-i-koh region.
importanceInUpsc: It is a seminal event in Indian history, representing the transition from localized tribal resistance to organized anti-colonial struggle, frequently tested for its socio-economic causes and administrative aftermath.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Tribal Movements Santhal Rebellion.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
